messages:
Elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance segment : Thanks for the transparency.
Maya: TL;DR: runway ~18 months assuming base plan; we have contingency levers if bookings underperform.
Devon: can you share the monthly burn breakdown (infra vs people vs ops)?
Maya: Sure  monthly ~ $3.2M: infra/GCP & GPUs ~ $1.3M, payroll ~ $1.4M, sales/marketing ~ $300k, other opex ~ $200k. Numbers are rounded.
Ravi: what's the threshold for triggering a formal hiring freeze?
Jared: Trigger is board-notified if runway drops below 12 months and bookings are behind plan. Until then we use selective freezes and role-by-role reviews.
Elena: procurement: new thresholds? last-week spike from a vendor renewal surprised a team.
ProcurementBot: New rules: any vendor charge > $10k requires Procurement + Finance review. Auto-hold for renewals > $15k until approval. Use http://redwood.internal/procure to submit.
Devon: does this impact AWS/GPU spot purchases?
Maya: Short-term, no change to day-to-day spot buys under $5k. Large reserved instance or committed GPU purchases must go through the ROI template and Finance.
Ravi: how fast will approvals be? last time it was 2 weeks.
ProcurementBot: SLA updates: <$5k: 2 business days; $5k	$20k: 5 business days; >$20k: 10 business days. Expedited path: include product lead + finance sponsor in ticket.
Elena: any new delegated budgets for Eng managers to avoid blocking sprint work?
Maya: Managers can approve up to $1,000 for tooling; Director approval required for $1k	$5k. Anything above needs Finance signoff.
Devon: curious about capex option for GPUs  could we buy racks to lower long-term cost?
Jared: We will consider capex for stable Dedicated pools. Any capex request > $200k requires a board notice and multi-scenario TCO.
Elena: will there be changes to customer credits or sales incentives?
Maya: No immediate changes. Sales incentives and customer credits reviewed monthly; big changes would be communicated well in advance.
Ravi: who is the contact if we need an exception for a customer-impacting spend imminently?
Maya: Tag @Jared and @Maya in the procurement ticket and mark it "expedite_customer" with justification and rollback plan. Expect a 24hr triage for true customer-impacting cases.
Devon: ok thanks 60a.
OpsBot: Heads-up: 3 vendor contracts expiring in 60 days were flagged and sent to Finance.
Elena: will this be reflected in onboarding docs? new hires ask about discretionary budgets often.
Maya: yes, updated onboarding notes will be posted to #devex and included in the new-hire packet.
Jared: Appreciate the questions. We're aiming for surgical controls rather than broad cuts; keep raising risks to your finance partners.
Elena: thanks all, closing thread.
